description:
Cloning

Ever installed Astral Ascension but found you would need to wait years for a size 9 colony in the first place?
Ever wanted to see those cool multipliers from having a Fractal Ecumenopolis — whatever that is, because you've never seen it without using console commands?
Ever installed Vulpoids and saw your celebrities produce 0.6% growth on a size 8?

Well, look no more.

Adds a three-tier cloning industry that massively boosts population growth — at a cost to stability.

This forum post is a duplicate of 35129 , since the previous one got a database error.

The code is fully open source under a license of "do whatever you want to do with it". You don't have to credit me, as claude code built this anyway.

Requires LunaLib.

Industry Chain
Adds a new industry available from the start, occupying an industry slot.
Three upgrade tiers, each producing more population growth than the last:
Clone Vat Experiments — entry-level, produces some population growth.
Cloning Industry — upgrade, produces more population growth.
Cloning Megafactory — top tier, produces a large amount of population growth. Tons of upkeep, credits and stability. Be prepared.

Growth scales with colony size when an Alpha or Omega core is installed, or when a pristine nanoforge is installed.
All tiers apply a stability penalty that scales with colony size — there are consequences for cutting corners on biology.

AI Core Effects
Gamma core — reduces upkeep. Cloning is expensive; every bit helps.
Beta core — reduces upkeep and produces crew and marines alongside population growth.
Alpha core — reduces upkeep, produces crew and marines, and growth now scales with colony size.
Omega core (Astral Ascension) — all Alpha benefits, plus doubled colony size scaling. Expect extremely large numbers. Go wild.

Configuration
Uses LunaLib for in-game settings.
Configurable values: base growth per tier, colony size scaling factor, and a global multiplier.
Players without LunaLib will use the built-in defaults.

FAQ
Is this mod overpowered?
Definitely yes, until I manage to balance it somehow. And I mean really overpowered — hitting over a thousand growth points on a size 7 colony is entirely possible right now.

What is planned?
DONE - Colony item integration.
TBA - Bigger penalties to match the big bonuses.
TBA - A way to acquire the Cloning blueprint from a difficult fight — maybe a Dorito.
TBA - Integration with AOTD (VOK)'s research system, involving the player in unlocking stat boosts while fighting for databanks.

Compatibility?
Should be compatible with everything. Tested with the Build Menu Overhaul from AOTD.
Tested on a 250-mod modpack with no crashes.

Version log
0.1.0
Initial Release
0.1.1
Fixed infinite recursion bug. Now playable.
0.2.1
Added support for story point improvement as well as two colony items:
Biofactory embryos and pristine nanoforge.

discordPostHtml:
Ever installed **Astral Ascension **but found you would need to wait years for a size 9 colony in the first place?
Ever wanted to see those cool multipliers from having a "Fractal Ecumonopolis", whatever that is because you've never seen it without using console commands?

Ever installed **Vulpoids **and saw your celebrities produce 0.6% growth on a size 8?

Well look no more:
Cloning

This mod adds an (available from the start) industry called "Cloning". It has one upgrade path, with 3 levels:

  1. Cloning Vat Experiments - Produces some pop growth
  2. Cloning industry - Produces more pop growth
  3. Cloning Megafactory - Produces tons of pop growth

Cloning takes up an industry slot.

Additionally, you can add AI cores to this industry for:
gamma: Reduced upkeep (this industry eats a lot of money)
beta: Now produces marines & crew in addition to pop growth
alpha: Now produces marines & crew and scales with market size.
(planned omega) - Alpha + 2x the colony size scaling rate. Will allow you to hit some bonkers numbers on popgrowth. Go wild, i guess.

Cloning incurs a stability penalty of ${COLONY_SIZE} just for any semblance of a demerit.

Uses Lunalib for user settings for values provided by this mod, and thus is a (soft) dependency. People without lunalib will face default values, but I set it as a hard-dep anyway in the modinfo.

FAQ:

  • Is this mod overpowered?

Definitely yes, until I can "Balans" is somehow
And I mean REALLY overpowered right now. I'm hitting over a thousand popgrowth on a 7-size colony.

  • What is planned in the future?

Colony item integration, big penalties for big bonuses, balance, a way to aquire the blueprint for cloning from a hard fight (maybe a dorito one?)
Also I plan to use AOTD(VOK)'s research system to involve the player in the stat boost a little bit more while fighting for databanks with the alternatives.

  • Compatibility?

Should be compatible with everything. Tested with build menu overhaul from AOTD as well.
Tested on a 250 mod modpack, no crashes.
